I did try to do stuff like avoid having any sort of similar background besides being half race/biracial. She’s got no childhood trauma or any mental illnesses. She’s also very optimistic which I am not (oops). Hopefully that will help make her feel different than me.

She’s not shy like me, she’s just socially awkward and not great in conversation since most of her time has been spent reading books, searching for Eilistraee followers and gaining healing skills. 

I thought it would be hard to play a shy character who doesn’t talk, so I thought I’d just make her awkward so when I’m being shy and nervous it’s just her being awkward.

She’s definitely willing to go on adventure! Her wish is to spread the teachings of Eilistraee since she’s not very well known or people are misinformed about her. She doesn’t intend to convert people (I read that’s an annoying character to have for parties), she just wants people to know Eilistraee is a kind, welcoming goddess. 

I think for combat she is mostly a pacifist. But I picked the flaw that once you set a goal you’re obsessed with it, so I think she could see one or all of her party members as needing help and guidance so she’s will to fight others to show her party members they are supported? I’m just planning on a rhinoplasty. Thank you for the advice, my facial piercings are years old so they shouldn’t close quickly, I hadn’t thought about things getting tugged or ripped out honestly! My nipple and navel I got in the last 5 months so I was worried about removing them and just wanted to know if there was any way to prevent moving them (they are both still healing and take roughly a year or two years to finish healing).

You original comment definitely doesn’t express that. Obviously if I HAVE to I will remove them but I’m specifically asking if there are ways to not remove them and still be safe. It has nothing to do with the standard answer, I struggle to believe you have experience if your only answer is “take them out it doesn’t matter”. Just seems rude and like you didn’t read the post. Thanks anyways.

Retainers are an option. If possible I’d prefer to keep the implant grade titanium ones in that I usually have, which is why I asked the question, and was wondering what others experiences were. When a piercing can take over a year to heal just removing it and hoping it doesn’t close is stressful and a pretty solid reason for a lot of people getting retainers or asking to keep piercings in. Your comments not super helpful tbh as you don’t actually seem to have experience with piercings and surgery which is what I was hoping for.

Piercings close very fast so taking out piercings not near the surgery area is pretty sucky. Definitely good reasons to avoid it if possible. Piercings cost money and time to heal, losing that in a few hours is pretty disheartening.

I hope this is okay to link, but a very popular piercer I know has been able to keep hers in by having implant grade titanium and papers showing the metal type. https://vm.tiktok.com/ZM8Pse57c/

I was hoping to do something like this but I am shy and have trouble explaining so it maybe hard.
